Reservationist Job at Galaxy La-Palm Royal Resort




        
    

        
        Galaxy La-Palm Royal Resort is a prestigious 5-star hotel and resort dedicated to providing exceptional hospitality, comfort, luxury, and memorable experiences to our guests. We offer world-class accommodation, quality dining, leisure and recreational facilities, spa and wellness services, conference and event spaces, and professional guest services.
     

            
    



Our commitment is to maintain the highest standards of excellence, cleanliness, safety, customer service, and professionalism, ensuring that every guest enjoys a comfortable and remarkable stay. We strive to create a warm, elegant, and welcoming environment that meets the expectations of both local and international guests. As a 5-star hospitality establishment, we are committed to continuous improvement, innovation, and delivering outstanding service that reflects the highest standards of the hospitality industry.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Reservationist 

Job Location: Port Harcourt, Rivers
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Responsibilities


	Manage room reservations through telephone, email, hotel website, walk-ins, and Online Travel Agencies (OTAs).
	Respond promptly and professionally to guest enquiries regarding room availability, rates, packages, and hotel facilities.
	Maintain accurate reservation records, room inventory, rates, cancellations, and amendments using the hotel’s PMS.
	Coordinate with Front Office, Housekeeping, Sales, and Accounts to ensure smooth guest arrivals and departures.
	Handle booking confirmations, modifications, cancellations, and special guest requests.
	Monitor and manage OTA bookings to ensure accurate room availability and rates.
	Promote room upgrades and other hotel services where appropriate.
	Provide excellent customer service in line with luxury five-star hotel standards.
	Prepare reservation reports and follow up on pending bookings and payments.
	Resolve reservation-related issues professionally and escalate complex matters to the appropriate supervisor.


Key Skills Required


	Excellent communication and customer service skills.
	Good knowledge of hotel reservation procedures and PMS.
	Strong practical experience with OTAs and online booking platforms.
	Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
	Good telephone and email etiquette.
	Strong organizational and multitasking skills.
	Good sales and upselling skills.
	Previous experience in a four- or five-star hotel is highly preferred.


Method of Application

Technician Job at Itel Energy




        
    

        
        Itel Energy is a renewable energy solutions company focused on providing reliable, affordable, and sustainable solar power solutions across Nigeria. As part of the itel ecosystem, Itel Energy leverages strong distribution networks and deep market reach to deliver innovative off-grid and hybrid solar solutions for homes, SMEs, and commercial customers.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Technician
Job Location: Abuja (FCT) 
Employment Type: Full-time 

Job Summary
     

            
    




	We are looking for a skilled and hands-on Technician to support the installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of our renewable energy products and systems.
	The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring that products are properly installed, maintained, and functioning efficiently while providing timely technical support to customers and service partners.


Key Responsibilities


	Install, test, commission, and maintain renewable energy systems, including inverters, batteries, solar systems, and related electrical components.
	Diagnose and troubleshoot technical faults in energy systems and identify appropriate solutions.
	Carry out preventive and corrective maintenance on installed systems.
	Perform system inspections, testing, and performance checks to ensure optimal operation.
	Repair or replace faulty components where necessary.
	Read and interpret electrical diagrams, wiring diagrams, technical manuals, and system specifications.
	Provide technical support and basic product guidance to customers and service partners.
	Maintain accurate records of installations, repairs, maintenance activities, and service reports.
	Ensure all technical activities comply with company procedures, safety standards, and applicable electrical regulations.
	Properly maintain and use technical tools, testing equipment, and other work materials.


Requirements & Qualifications


	OND, HND, or B.Sc. in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Renewable Energy, or a related technical field.
	1–3 years of hands-on experience in electrical, solar, inverter, battery, or renewable energy systems.
	Good knowledge of electrical wiring, inverters, batteries, and solar/energy storage systems.
	Ability to diagnose and troubleshoot electrical and technical faults.
	Proficiency in using basic electrical testing and diagnostic tools.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

        Itel  Energy is a renewable energy solutions company focused on providing reliable, affordable, and sustainable solar power solutions across Nigeria. 	Resolve channel-related issues and ensure good partner relationships.


Requirements


	Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent qualification in Business, Marketing, Sales, or a related field.
	3–5 years of experience in channel sales, distribution, or business development.
	Experience in the energy / renewable energy industry is an added advantage.
	Strong communication, negotiation, and relationship-management skills.

Customer Experience & Support Officer Job at ATRaS Mobility Ecosystem




        
    

        
        ATRaS Mobility Ecosystem, Launched by  P-GAT Industries is a landmark N300 billion transport modernization and green initiative to revolutionize regional logistics and transportation across Northeast Nigeria. Officially unveiled in mid-2026, the comprehensive platform drastically cuts commuting costs while modernizing the local economy.

We are recruiting to fill the position below: 

 Job Position: Customer Experience & Support Officer

Job Locations: Numan, Yola, Mubi, Adamawa

Role Summary
     

            
    




	
	Provide customer support, resolve service issues, document complaints, coordinate escalations, and help maintain a reliable and positive customer experience across ATRAS operations.
	


Minimum Requirements


	Diploma/ND or equivalent in Customer Service, Business Administration, Communications, Management, or a related field.
	Minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in customer service, support, service operations, or a related role.
	Excellent communication, listening, problem-solving, and conflict-resolution skills.
	Comfortable working with digital customer records and reporting systems.


Other Requirements:


	All applicants must be at least 18 years of age.
	All applicants must be ready and available to work in Adamawa State, Nigeria.
	All positions are full-time employment positions. Part-time or contract engagement may be considered on a case-by-case basis, subject to operational requirements and management approval.
	Applicants must provide accurate information and verifiable academic, professional, and employment records. Misrepresentation may lead to disqualification or termination of engagement.
	Applicants should demonstrate integrity, professionalism, reliability, teamwork, willingness to learn, and commitment to service delivery.
	Unless a role-specific requirement states otherwise, the minimum educational qualification for non-state-level positions is a Diploma/ND or equivalent relevant qualification.
	Applicants must possess the applicable current credentials (professional licences, registrations, or certifications) required to lawfully perform the role.


Employment Terms


	This postion is intended as full-time employment 
	Part-time or contract-based engagement may be considered on a case-by-case basis where the role, operational need, and candidate profile justify such an arrangement.
	Successful candidates may be required to work across assigned operational locations within Adamawa State and to participate in field activities where applicable.
	Working hours, reporting lines, compensation, benefits, probation, leave, and other employment conditions will be communicated to shortlisted candidates during the selection and offer process.


Remuneration & Benefits


	We offer competitive remuneration commensurate with the responsibilities of the position, the candidate's qualifications, relevant experience, and applicable employment terms.
	Details of salary, benefits, and other applicable terms will be disclosed to shortlisted candidates during the selection and offer process.
	Employment Type: Full-time (part-time or contract-based engagement may be considered on a case-by-case basis, depending on the role and operational requirements).


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their Applications to: [email protected] using "ATRAS  Recruitment - [Position] - [Preferred Location] " as the subject of the email.
